concepts.definition: Angular momentum is the cross product of position and momentum operators.

concepts.front: General vs orbital angular momentum quantum numbers
concepts.definition: The abstract angular-momentum algebra allows half-integer values, but single-valued scalar orbital wavefunctions only allow integer l. Spin can be half-integer.
concepts.key_rule: General j = 0, ½, 1, 3/2, …; orbital l = 0, 1, 2, …; m = −j,…,j (or −l,…,l)

workbook_verification_notes.heading: Basis
workbook_verification_notes.note: Compared existing Chapter 5 deck with uploaded QMChapter5(2).pdf; added standard derived formulas explicitly labelled as such.

workbook_verification_notes.heading: Lecture (5.18)
workbook_verification_notes.note: Printed L² eigenvalue appears as ℏ l(l+1); dimensional consistency requires ℏ² l(l+1). Existing card correctly uses ℏ².

workbook_verification_notes.heading: Lecture (5.39)
workbook_verification_notes.note: Printed exponential appears e^(±iθ); standard correct orbital ladder operator has e^(±iφ). Correct form added.

workbook_verification_notes.heading: General vs orbital l
workbook_verification_notes.note: Abstract angular momentum permits half-integer j, but orbital angular momentum of scalar wavefunctions has integer l. Original card clarified.

workbook_verification_notes.heading: Lecture (5.78)
workbook_verification_notes.note: Claim about V(r)=o(1/√r) as necessary for bound states is not a general criterion. Do not memorize as a law.

workbook_verification_notes.heading: Lecture (5.104)
workbook_verification_notes.note: Hydrogen radial-function scaling and Laguerre conventions must be used consistently; workbook gives the reliable proportional form.

workbook_verification_notes.heading: SI vs script conventions
workbook_verification_notes.note: The script defines e₀² as the Coulomb coupling. SI formulas explicitly use 4πε₀ and electron charge e.

workbook_verification_notes.heading: Scope
workbook_verification_notes.note: The original 59 cards are retained (one clarified), with 24 new cards and a high-priority BOX sheet.

workbook_verification_notes.heading: Study priority
workbook_verification_notes.note: Study BOX first, then the complete Learning Cards tab; check derivations and conventions before using any formula in an exam.

workbook_import_note: 83 actual learning cards; Study Guide still reports the old 59. Raw LaTeX and renderer instructions are metadata, not Telegram HTML.
